techniques.name: Selective event sourcing
techniques.goal: Preserve reconstructable history for audit-critical state without event-sourcing everything
techniques.mechanism: Store immutable domain events as source of truth only for states whose history/replay matters; derive current projections/snapshots for reads.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use current-state records for ordinary data; event-source only where historical causality is valuable.
avoid_when: Large raw telemetry already append-only but not canonical

techniques.name: Append-only event log + materialized view
techniques.goal: Combine forensic history with fast current-state queries
techniques.mechanism: Append immutable events, then reduce them into compact projections optimized for UI/search/status.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Existing Agent OS telemetry should increasingly expose deterministic reducers/rebuild checks.
avoid_when: Simple state with no history value

techniques.name: Snapshot + replay
techniques.goal: Bound replay time while retaining event history
techniques.mechanism: Periodically persist verified state snapshot plus event offset; recover snapshot then replay only later events.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Snapshot is derived/rebuildable, not an independent source of truth.

techniques.name: Transactional outbox
techniques.goal: Prevent local state change and outbound event/action request from diverging after crash
techniques.mechanism: Commit business state and pending outbound message/action descriptor in same local transaction; relay separately.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use stable event/action IDs and idempotent consumer.

techniques.name: Idempotent consumer
techniques.goal: Make at-least-once event delivery safe
techniques.mechanism: Record processed event IDs/version and ensure replayed duplicate produces same final state without duplicate side effect.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Every inbound provider event adapter declares stable source identity/revision semantics.
avoid_when: Events represent intentionally repeatable additive action with unique identity per occurrence
risks: Bad identity scope suppresses valid update

techniques.name: At-least-once delivery + idempotency instead of pretending exactly-once
techniques.goal: Use realistic retry semantics and handle duplicates explicitly
techniques.mechanism: Design queues/adapters assuming an acknowledged message/action can be retried after uncertain failure and make processing idempotent.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Do not label workflow 'exactly once' unless exact scope and proof are defined.
avoid_when: Underlying transaction truly provides atomic exactly-once within one database

techniques.name: Saga / compensating workflow
techniques.goal: Coordinate multi-service side effects without global transaction
techniques.mechanism: Execute ordered local actions and define compensating action/mitigation for each reversible step if later step fails.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Preview/approval before first irreversible step; explicit residual-state handling.
avoid_when: Operation can be made one atomic service call
Compensation cannot meaningfully undo irreversible harm

techniques.name: Circuit breaker around failing dependency
techniques.goal: Prevent repeated failures from consuming resources and cascading
techniques.mechanism: Track recent failures; open breaker and fail/route quickly; probe for recovery before closing.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Breaker state should be visible to router/UI and not count as model-quality failure.
avoid_when: Failure should be retried per-operation and cannot cascade

techniques.name: Bulkhead isolation
techniques.goal: Stop one workload/provider from exhausting resources needed by others
techniques.mechanism: Use separate concurrency pools/queues/processes/budgets for independent dependency/workload classes.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Protect interactive/control-plane capacity from background Agent OS work.

techniques.name: Backpressure
techniques.goal: Keep producers from overwhelming downstream processing
techniques.mechanism: Bound queues and signal/throttle/pause producers or compact low-value events when consumers fall behind.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Never silently drop; use priority/retention/compaction policy with audit counts.
avoid_when: Lossless source cannot be paused and queue can scale safely
risks: Poor policy can lose valuable events

techniques.name: Dead-letter / quarantine queue
techniques.goal: Prevent one poison event from blocking an entire ingestion stream
techniques.mechanism: After bounded retries/classification, isolate problematic item with error/provenance for later repair while continuing independent work.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Outstanding failure queue must have review/expiry/retry policy.
avoid_when: Failure indicates systemic corruption requiring full stop

techniques.name: Lease + heartbeat for claimed work
techniques.goal: Recover jobs abandoned by crashed workers without duplicate active ownership
techniques.mechanism: Worker acquires expiring lease, periodically renews; expired lease makes work reclaimable while operation IDs maintain idempotency.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Existing Agent OS work claims/ingestion ledgers already approximate this pattern.

techniques.name: Monotonic revision numbers / optimistic concurrency
techniques.goal: Prevent silent lost updates while allowing independent readers
techniques.mechanism: Read object with version, write only if expected version matches; on conflict refetch/reconcile.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Every shared mutable record should have clear version/conflict semantics.

techniques.name: Compare-and-swap / conditional mutation
techniques.goal: Make state transitions atomic and invariant-preserving
techniques.mechanism: Apply mutation only if current state/version/status satisfies precondition.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: State machine transition validator + version check.

techniques.name: Schema versioning + reader/writer compatibility
techniques.goal: Let old durable records survive newer code/models
techniques.mechanism: Persist schema version/writer representation; readers explicitly migrate/resolve supported older forms rather than assuming current shape.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Future model must be able to identify exact record schema and migration chain.

techniques.name: Additive schema evolution first
techniques.goal: Reduce breaking migrations
techniques.mechanism: Prefer optional/defaulted new fields and new variants before removing/renaming/retyping existing fields; deprecate then migrate.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Every deprecated field has removal criteria/date, not indefinite compatibility.
avoid_when: Field is dangerous/incorrect and must be removed immediately

techniques.name: Canonical schema hashing
techniques.goal: Identify semantically identical schema versions independent of irrelevant serialization details
techniques.mechanism: Normalize schema representation to canonical form and hash it for cache/provenance/compatibility checks.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use schema content hash in eval/run provenance.
avoid_when: Canonicalization loses semantically relevant extension metadata

techniques.name: Run/job/dataset lineage model
techniques.goal: Make transformations auditable from exact inputs through executable activity to outputs
techniques.mechanism: Represent reusable job definition separately from run instance and input/output data/artifact versions, adding facets for code/model/schema/test metadata.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Adapt OpenLineage concepts to model/tool/prompt transformations rather than copy spec wholesale.

techniques.name: Field/claim-level lineage for derived knowledge
techniques.goal: Avoid attributing an entire output to every input when only some fields/claims depend on each source
techniques.mechanism: Record exact source claims/fields/chunks used to derive each promoted fact or output field where material.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Supports correction propagation: changed source can identify affected claims.
avoid_when: Low-risk aggregate where coarse lineage is sufficient

techniques.name: Lineage-based invalidation
techniques.goal: Recompute only outputs actually dependent on changed source/version
techniques.mechanism: Traverse source→job→artifact/claim edges and mark affected derived state stale/requeue it.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Promotion requires dependency refs sufficient for future targeted reconciliation.
risks: Missed lineage edge leaves invalid output

techniques.name: Local-first authoritative working state
techniques.goal: Keep core user work available/offline and under user control while optionally syncing
techniques.mechanism: Write locally first, provide immediate response, then replicate/sync to remote/canonical stores under explicit semantics.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Git remains canonical for reviewed durable artifacts; high-frequency/private state can be local-first DB.
avoid_when: Shared authoritative enterprise system must remain server-owned

techniques.name: CRDT-based merge for truly concurrent multi-device state
techniques.goal: Allow offline concurrent edits to converge without central locking
techniques.mechanism: Choose a CRDT whose merge semantics match domain (set/map/counter/text/etc.) and exchange operations/state until replicas converge.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only use after specifying human-meaningful concurrent edit semantics.
use_when: Multi-device notes/capture/tags where merge semantics are valid
risks: CRDT converges syntactically but may violate domain intent

techniques.name: Explicit semantic conflict instead of automatic merge
techniques.goal: Avoid silently inventing intent when concurrent changes are incompatible
techniques.mechanism: When two changes cannot be safely merged by domain rule, preserve both versions/evidence and create conflict requiring deterministic rule or human resolution.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Convergence is not correctness; conflicting decisions stay explicit.

techniques.name: SQLite WAL for high-frequency single-machine state
techniques.goal: Support durable local queues/indexes with concurrent readers/writer and low operational overhead
techniques.mechanism: Use SQLite WAL for appropriate workstation-local DBs, keep canonical/rebuildable distinction clear.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Matches current Agent OS local staging philosophy.

techniques.name: Single-writer canonical promotion boundary
techniques.goal: Reduce canonical merge conflicts and accidental concurrent promotion
techniques.mechanism: Allow many observers/workers to create local/candidate evidence, but serialize validated promotions through one deterministic transition/merge policy.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Parallel research is fine; canonical truth transition is controlled.
